title: Psychology Facts
hook: Why can't you stop thinking about that one unfinished thing?
facts: Unfinished tasks tend to stay in your head *more* than finished ones.
That's why a half-watched series, or an unanswered message, keeps *nagging* you.
The fix? Write down exactly *when* you'll finish it. Your brain relaxes.
outro: Now you know why you can't stop thinking about it.
